java.at: private final MollieClient mollie = new MollieClient();
java.say: CashRegister makes a MollieClient itself: a class from an external payment library. CashRegister is high level; Mollie is a detail.
checkout() calls the library directly, in the library's own terms: cents, as a whole number.
Another payment provider means changing CashRegister. The high level depends on the detail.
